newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 25.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Barry-Callebaut chairman tells Ivory Coast's president, Henri Konan Bedie, his company plans to promote use of Ivorian cocoa processed in Singapore for further processing in China and for use in chocolate for distribution across Asia; Kalus Jacob says merger between Cacao Barry and Callebaut that formed the new giant of the chocolate industry aimed at helping conquer new markets. The two men are due to meet again on Wednesday.

- Fuel distribution union SYNTEPCI announces 48-hour strike from Wednesday to back demands for pay rises and respect of union rights. Head of union announced on state radio on Wednesday that the call had been suspended

- Ivorian government formally sells off Assinie coconut plantation and Vridi palm oil factory belonging to state agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie at special signing ceremony; state also sells off stake in credit company SAFBAIL and electrical installation company SIDELAF
- Transporters say rise in gasoline and other motor fuel costs following government liberalisation of pump prices could push up bus and other transport prices
- Service station owners blame rise in gasoline and other motor fuel prices on rising world oil prices
